item.title: Rajasthan: Six women killed, three seriously injured in truck-car collision on NH-52
item.description: The collision occurred on National Highway-52 near Harsawa village in the Fatehpur sub-division when a car carrying women collided with a speeding truck, completely destroying the vehicle.

item.title: ‘Chamatkar’ or medical emergency? Dog circling Hanuman idol for 36 hours goes viral
item.description: A dog circling a Hanuman idol for 36 hours drew crowds calling it a “chamatkar.” As the video went viral, faith clashed with concern until AI Grok offered a medical explanation that changed the debate.

item.title: Rising Iran Tensions: US withdrawing troops from key Middle East bases; Full story here
item.description: The US is evacuating troops from key Middle East bases amid rising tensions with Iran, following Tehran’s threat to target American forces. The move comes as Iran faces deadly protests and President Trump urges citizens to continue demonstrating.

item.title: Anything less than having Greenland in US hands ‘unacceptable’: US President Donald Trump
item.description: Trump calls Greenland “vital” for US security, pushing for American control to deploy the Golden Dome missile defense system. Denmark and Greenland reject the demand, raising tensions ahead of high-level White House talks.

item.title: Google Pixel 10a could launch sooner than expected: Know expected features, specs and price range
item.description: Google Pixel 10a could arrive as soon as February 2026 with a 48MP camera, 120Hz AMOLED display, and 5,100mAh battery. But is Google using the Tensor G4 or something else? Here’s what leaks reveal about its surprise features and price.

item.title: ED files SLP in Supreme Court in West Bengal I-PAC search row; Full story here
item.description: A late-night search, allegations of interference, and a rare legal escalation- the Enforcement Directorate has approached the Supreme Court over its West Bengal operation. What really happened during the I-PAC raid is now set for judicial scrutiny.

item.description: These elections will not only decide the future of Mumbai but also serve as a crucial test for the political survival of Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray.

item.title: Over 2.1 million devotees take holy dip by morning at Magh Mela
item.description: On the occasion of Makar Sankranti, a massive influx of devotees gathered at the Sangam in Prayagraj for the holy dip during Magh Mela 2026. Despite dense fog and cold weather, over 2.1 million pilgrims had taken a ritual bath by 8 a.m. Authorities expect the number to cross 10 million by evening, with extensive security and traffic arrangements in place.

item.title: Delhi NCR shivers under cold wave as dense fog disrupts daily life
item.description: Thick fog reduced visibility to near-zero levels in many places, disrupting road, rail, and air transportation. Aviation services were the most affected, with poor visibility at IGI Airport causing delays to at least 54 flights.
